newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Bank MCB stocks push Mauritius bourse index up.
newsitem.headline: Bank MCB stocks push Mauritius bourse index up.

text.p: The Mauritius Commercial Bank (MCB) pushed up market index Semdex at the Stock Exchange of Mauritius on Friday, bourse officials said.
Semdex gained 0.92 points to 379.72 on transaction volume of 27.17 million rupees on 1,252,434 shares from 26.92 million rupees on 1,131,191 shares last Wednesday.

MCB was 1.50 rupee higher to 87.00 rupees on 103,292 shares, State Bank of Mauritius (SBM) was unchanged at 13.00 rupees on 902,800 shares, whereas the British American Insurance (BAI) lost 40 cents to 8.10 rupees on 64,422 shares.

Hotel-based Sun Resorts climbed 20 cents to 46.90 rupees on 62,699 shares, New Mauritius Hotels (NMH) was stable at 35.30 rupees on 32,775 shares and Grand Baie Hotel was unchanged at 45.00 rupees on 2,971 shares.

In the commerce sector, Shell lost 40 cents to 21.20 rupees on 15,426 shares. Conglomerates Ireland Blyth Ltd fell 10 cents to 14.50 on 7,761 shares and Rogers was stable at 101.00 rupees on 730 shares.
In the transport sector, national carrier Air Mauritius was unchanged to 39.70 rupees on 6,171 shares.
